I’d prefer “Read later” to start unticked so adding something to that queue is deliberate. Saving a bookmark doesn’t necessarily mean I haven’t read it.

Ordinary saved references should look just as prominent as other bookmarks in the All view. They’re still useful items I’m keeping on purpose, not completed tasks to fade away. A small reading-state label or the action button is enough to distinguish them; the To read filter already gives queued items their focused view.

With those two adjustments, the read-later flow feels right.
